1820.s: …a moment, so portly in his dimensions, and decked out in gorgeous apparel ; then cast a glance upon his own threadbare and starveling condition, and the scanty bundle which he held in his hand; then giving his shrunk waistcoat a twitch to make it meet his receding waistband; and casting another look, half sad, half humorous, at the sturdy yeoman, “I suppose, ” said he, “Mr. Tibbets, you have forgot old times and old playmates."
